validation_data_policy.published_facts: Small factual records must cite DOI/page/table/equation, precision, transformations and source terms. No complete paper table or supplementary dataset is included by this manifest.
validation_data_policy.waibel_main_text_pointwise_coverage: No complete paired input/objective records identified for the ten scoped continuous problems. Supplementary contents require separate inventory.
validation_data_policy.reference_code_equivalence: Separate original-C#/8.5 baseline; reconstructed runs must not be mislabeled as published measurements.
known_paper_code_discrepancies: Waibel Eq. (7): minimum window height 0.55 m; reference C# problems 9/10: 0.5488 m.
Detailed-office fan/electricity accounting is recorded separately in implementation validation notes.
